text:
Aisha (AE): Meridian Health POC kickoff. Scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM for ~15k users, RBAC mapping from Okta groups, automated domain verification, EU data residency. Need POC pricing and SQ answers by Friday.
Carlos (SE): We support SP + IdP flows, cert rollover, SCIM v2 push. Note: nested Okta groups get flattened on mapping. Recommend initial bulk import + delta sync.
Priya (SRE): Hosted in eu-west-1 meets EU residency for POC. Dedicated gives VPC + customer KMS but needs ~2wk lead. I can spin up demo hosted env in 48h.
Liam (Security): Send the security questionnaire. Immediate gates: DPA EU addendum, confirm keys at rest in EU, SAML must include email/sub/groups. SCIM over TLS; mTLS optional for Private.
Aisha (AE): Pricing ask: 3-month POC committed vs hosted trial.
Carlos (SE): Ballpark: Hosted trial with $5k credit + $3k/mo support retainer. Dedicated POC: ~ $22-26k/mo (2x A100 equiv) with 15% intro discount possible.
Priya (SRE): For 15k initial import on Hosted we'll schedule a bulk window; if they need <24h cutover choose Dedicated. I'll enable a temporary rate-limit bump for SCIM.
Aisha (AE): Action items: Carlos -> SAML/SCIM sample + claim mapping (EOD tomorrow). Priya -> spin demo env (48h). Liam -> annotated SQ (72h). I'll draft pricing options.
Carlos (SE): sample mapping snippet: {"groups_claim":"groups","role_map":{"meridian-admins":"admin","meridian-users":"user"}}
ops-bot: demo-hosted-eu build started by Priya (SRE) -> job #421, health checks pending.
Aisha (AE): Can everyone hit their items to keep Friday deadline?
Carlos (SE): Confirmed.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed. Will post link in #secure-shared.
Liam (Security): Confirmed; legal may need extra time for DPA wording.
Aisha (AE): Thanks team — I'll combine and send proposal once docs + demo link are up.
